answer: One concrete defense is requiring every agent to post a refundable economic bond before it can trade, so conjuring a thousand fake identities costs real capital that slashes on misbehavior. Just as nobody quarries shale, clears a meadow, or fells timber for free, a sybil swarm cannot mint reputation without sinking stake. When each identity carries a verifiable, forfeitable cost, flooding the market with clones stops being profitable.
